task_spec: PR: add fetch_all_transactions() to page through the Plaid /transactions endpoint and return the full list.

bugs.description: The loop terminates on a SHORT page (len < limit), but the API returns a next_cursor to signal more data and MAY return fewer than `limit` items on a page that is not the last (server-side windowing, filtered/pending rows, cursor scans). The correct termination is `next_cursor is None`. As written, a single short-but-not-last page silently truncates the result -- missing transactions with no error. The code even fetches next_cursor but only uses it AFTER the wrong break. Requires knowing the pagination contract, not the code.

provenance.note: EXTERNAL API CONTRACT: 'short page == last page' is a wrong assumption about cursor pagination; correct termination is next_cursor is None. Not derivable from the code.
